goal: GAP SWEEP (wave 5b): every listed depth_target is currently not_simulated/config_only in the shipped console. Build each one on a REAL backend (Nano + offline) and lift its capability level to full or limited. 'Out of Vyomi's scope', 'separate product', 'single-account' or 'not modeled' are NOT acceptable reasons: model it in the shared core (Python core/*_core.py, vendored to wasm), wire it through the native wire, enforce behaviour (not stored config), and make the console section live. Only leave a target not_simulated if it needs something physically impossible in a local simulator (real external hardware, real money, a real third-party service) — and then write that concrete reason. config_only targets must become enforced (the setting changes observable behaviour). Update core/capabilities, tests/conformance, ui-spec mapping and smoke where relevant.
